description: Gameplay-only compact territory groups, not historical or diplomatic borders. Map records, settlement country codes and original borders retain their source identities.
selection: Explicit compact territories with reference population <= 2.5 million are assigned to a touching larger neighbor; small island groups use a nearby regional neighbor. Disputed map records CYN and SOL join their encompassing map country. Large-area sparsely populated nations and remote islands stay playable. No runtime population threshold silently changes the roster.
